units.content: Adaptive Intelligence Theory (AIT) — Mathematical Foundation.
AIT is modeled as a recursive dynamical system improving representations, expanding controllable future space, and preserving corrective feedback.
System state is S_t=(E_t,R_t,M_t,A_t).
In PAGE_4 system-state context, E_t denotes external environment state.
In PAGE_4 system-state context, R_t denotes internal representation of reality.
In PAGE_4 system-state context, M_t denotes model / search mechanism.
In PAGE_4 system-state context, A_t denotes available action space.
System evolution is written S_t -> S_{t+1}.
Observation stage: Y_t=O(E_t).
Representation stage: R_t=f(Y_t).
Prediction stage: E_hat_{t+1}=M_t(R_t).
Action selection is written A_t=pi(R_t,M_t), reusing A_t in the PAGE_4 loop/action context.
Environment transition: E_{t+1}=T(E_t,A_t).
Complete information flow: Environment -> Observation -> Representation -> Model/Search -> Action -> Environment.
Intelligence is stated to be capacity to improve the adaptive loop over time.
Possibility space is the set of future environment states E_{t+n} reachable from S_t.
Capability expansion is written Delta Omega = Omega(S_{t+1}) - Omega(S_t).
Reachable future space is partitioned as Omega = Omega^+ union Omega^- for beneficial and harmful reachable futures.
Alignment objective proposed as Delta Omega^+ > Delta Omega^-.
Representation quality Q_R is defined as I(R;E)/C(R).
I(R;E) denotes mutual information between representation and reality in the Q_R formula.
C(R) denotes representation complexity in the Q_R formula; this C(R) is source-local and not automatically identical to correction/capability symbols C elsewhere.
Representation-quality objective is to maximize useful information while minimizing unnecessary complexity.
Source names this objective the principle of invariant-preserving compression; label does not establish a proved invariant theorem.
Resolution horizon is defined as H(S)=f(I,R,C,O).
In the resolution-horizon formula I=available information, R=representational capacity, C=computational capacity, O=observation quality; these local symbol meanings are not globally canonicalized.
Beyond the resolution horizon, additional computation is stated to produce increasing uncertainty rather than additional recoverable structure.
Causal Mass is defined as KL divergence between future-environment distributions conditioned on system presence vs removal.
In CM(S), S denotes system exists and not-S denotes system removed.
High causal mass is interpreted as system removal substantially altering future outcomes.
Counterfactual Reachability Mass is defined as |Omega(S)-Omega(not S)|.
High CRM is interpreted as many future states becoming unreachable if the system is removed.
In PAGE_4 Alignment Condition context, C_t is redefined as capability growth.
In PAGE_4 Alignment Condition context, A_t is redefined as alignment (or correction) capacity.
Stable capability expansion proposed to require A_t >= C_t under PAGE_4 alignment/capability meanings.
Instability regime proposed when C_t > A_t under PAGE_4 alignment/capability meanings.
Source interprets C_t>A_t as world-changing ability exceeding error-detection/correction ability.
Representation update: R_{t+1}=R_t+Delta R(feedback).
Defining characteristic of intelligence is stated not to be mere optimization but capacity to improve the optimization process itself.
Complete adaptive system equation: S_{t+1}=F(S_t,feedback).
Transition function F is stated to be adaptive rather than fixed; intelligent systems are proposed to improve transition dynamics while preserving alignment with reality.
Summary states representations determine what futures become reachable.
Summary states actions transform the environment.
Summary states feedback improves future representations.
Summary states alignment preserves corrective mechanisms required for sustained capability growth.
Source defines intelligence's key property as continual improvement of processes that discover, evaluate, and create future possibilities rather than static capability.
Source labels PAGE_5 as ADAPTIVE INTELLIGENCE THEORY — FINAL SYNTHESIS; label is preserved without granting final or superseding authority.
Core model diagram: Reality -> Representation -> Compression -> Prediction -> Action -> Reality Change -> Feedback -> loop.
Source states intelligence's purpose is not merely to optimize but to improve the loop itself.
Representation question: can the system build an accurate and useful model of reality?
Representation shorthand: R=f(Environment).
Better representations are stated to create larger reachable futures.
Reachability question: what futures become possible because of the system?
Omega(S) is stated to be reachable future space.
Capability is represented as Delta Omega > 0.
Source states intelligence/capability expands both opportunity and risk.
Stability question: can the system correct itself faster than it changes the world?
Alignment condition stated verbally as Correction capacity >= Capability growth.
System is stated to remain safe when adaptation keeps pace with influence.
Final synthesis describes Resolution Horizon as limits of what can currently be known; exact endpoint unresolved.
Final synthesis describes Representation Elasticity as ability to update internal models; exact endpoint unresolved.
Final synthesis describes IICG as tools changing what computation is possible; exact endpoint unresolved.
Final synthesis describes Causal Mass/CRM as how much future space depends on a system; exact endpoints unresolved.
Final synthesis describes Causal Permeability as ability to absorb corrective information; exact endpoint unresolved.
Final synthesis describes CGET as balance between generative expansion and stabilizing constraints; exact endpoint/acronym expansion unresolved.
Final synthesis describes Alignment Spine as keeping capability connected to correction; exact endpoint unresolved.
AIT is stated to study how systems increase ability to model, transform, and create reality while preserving feedback required to remain aligned.
Final goal stated as maximum adaptive capability with preserved correction, not maximum intelligence.
